text: わたしの　せいで　まけちゃったのかな

patterns.name: 〜のせいで
patterns.explanation: のせいで puts the blame for something bad on a person or thing. わたしの　せいで = 'because of me, it's my fault'.

patterns.name: 〜かな
patterns.explanation: かな at the end means 'I wonder', and の before it makes it a search for the explanation. まけちゃったのかな = 'I wonder if that's why we lost'.

patterns.name: 〜てしまう
patterns.explanation: てしまう after a verb says the thing happened completely, often to your regret. ちゃった is the casual shortened てしまった. まけちゃった = 'we went and lost'.
